items.hed: The Astros named Brad Ausmus as their next manager, reuniting him with the organization where he caught two trips to the playoffs
items.insight: MLB.com reports Ausmus, the Yankees' bench coach the past three seasons, returns to Houston after ten seasons there as a catcher across two stints, including the 2004 and 2005 NLCS runs. New general manager Randy Flores said Ausmus stood out in the interview process for the leadership and energy needed to build a winning culture. Ausmus will be formally introduced at a Daikin Park press conference Friday.
items.image_caption: Minute Maid Park (now Daikin Park), 2010. Venue still.

items.hed: Houston (8-3) hosts Golden State (8-3) Wednesday night at Toyota Center in a matchup of two hot starts
items.insight: The Rockets enter off Monday's 110-100 win over Denver, in which Kevin Durant nearly posted a triple-double, while the Warriors arrive winners of eight straight behind Stephen Curry's recent scoring surge. The official team page lists both clubs tied in the standings entering tip-off, giving the home crowd a measuring-stick game against one of the league's streakiest teams.

items.hed: The Texans visit Cleveland on Sunday at 1 p.m. Eastern for their Week 10 test
items.insight: Houston's official game guide places the matchup at Huntington Bank Field on FOX. The Texans arrive after an eight-sack defensive performance and a five-touchdown day from C.J. Stroud, giving the road game a clear measure of whether that complete effort carries forward.
